title: Rolling Stone profiles Philip K. Dick (1974?)
dek_or_short_description: A scanned mid-1970s Rolling Stone feature on Dick — catalogued, but not yet readable.
body_markdown:
This archive holds an eleven-page *Rolling Stone* feature on Philip K. Dick, catalogued under the year 1974. It is, on the catalog's own terms, a significant object: mainstream-press attention to Dick at a moment when his readership was still largely inside the science-fiction world.

Two cautions travel with it. First, the scan carries no machine-readable text, so nothing can yet be said about what the article actually argues — only that it exists. Second, the recorded date sits oddly next to the best-known *Rolling Stone* piece on Dick, Paul Williams's profile, which is dated November 1975. Until the page images are read and the date is reconciled, this record is a pointer, not a source.
summary: Catalogued but un-OCR'd Rolling Stone feature on PKD; flagged for a dating discrepancy and held pending a grounded reading.
revision_notes: DRAFT only. Cannot advance to 'reviewed' until a grounded raw_extraction (post-OCR) and a non-warn validation exist for this source, and the 1974/1975 date is resolved. The prose is deliberately explicit about uncertainty and asserts nothing about the article's contents.
